It's like he hits ya so damn hard ya actually leave yer own body. It's when ya come back that ya feel the pain. An' ya realize yer goin' toe-to-toe with a walkin' earthquake.

—Wolverine[source]

Gamma Mutate Physiology: Due to Banner being exposed to the Gamma Bomb's radiation, which culminated in his transformation into a powerful monster,[2] the gamma radiation mutated Hulk's body and fortified his cellular structure, adding over 800 pounds of bone marrow and muscle tissue to his body.[544] In addition, during times of stress the Incredible Hulk's adrenaline level escalates, causing a corresponding escalation of brute strength; thus, the madder Hulk gets, the stronger Hulk gets.[545][546] It has been said that when it comes to anger, Hulk knows no limits.[63] Echoing Marvel's understanding, Spider-Man once created a hierarchical system regarding physical power in which Hulk occupies first place, surpassing both Thor and Hercules.[547] Amadeus Cho, who is renowned for his ability to compute data flows, also stated that even a team comprised of Hercules would be worthless against an enraged Hulk.[548] A totally animalistic Hulk, although weakening, was stated and demonstrated as an even match for two ensembles of Avengers composed of powerful heroes, such as Namor the Sub-Mariner, Hercules, Wonder Man and Iron Man.[549][76] During an argument with the Illuminati, Namor the Sub-Mariner inferred that no power on the planet Earth could contend against the raging Hulk should he eventually return.[550] Amadeus Cho substantiated this statement upon claiming that if Hulk had not suppressed his fury, he would have destroyed everyone in the World War Hulk event.[39] Hulk was too described as God's counterweight to balance creation with destruction.[53]

Hulk was also defined as the most powerful creature on the face of the Earth, as his inconceivable power astonished even Doctor Strange.[551] During a dialogue at a conference that was orchestrated by Doctor Strange, he stated to the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, and other super-heroes that if Banner's control ever truly collapsed, Hulk could potentially be the greatest threat that these heroes had ever faced.[474] The Incredible Hulk has been described several times as one of the physically most powerful beings in the entire Marvel Universe,[219][335][552][482][553][554] and as one of the most powerful beings ever to walk the Earth,[555][556][557] with the potential for limitless levels of strength and durability (since it scales directly with his strength).[558] Hulk, in the full exercise of his potential, was described as the most powerful mortal entity in all of existence,[559] and his maximum known strength level ranges beyond the limits of virtually any other known humanoid being.[546][5] Hulk's vast physical might has even been described as powerful enough to ravage entire worlds.[560] Moreover, Hulk was also stated to be an Omega Level Threat by both the Initiative[561] and Mister Fantastic,[562] and even "the Original Omega Level Threat" by Henry Peter Gyrich.[35] Hulk was once stated to be the strongest super-hero on planet Earth.[535]

Additionally, Hulk was also referred as the strongest member of an Avengers team featuring Hercules.[563] Doctor Strange has even referenced Hulk as one of the most powerful beings in the whole of existence.[483] Besides, Hulk was indicated as stronger than anything alive.[408] Gamiel the Manipulator probed Hulk's untapped potential and reasoned that he is the pinnacle of the human species.[187] In addition, the Atlantean warlord Attuma recognized Hulk as the mightiest creature in the world.[564] Hulk was further considered as excessively powerful for the Renegades to confront, a group including Hercules himself.[565] As Onslaught had assimilated Franklin Richards into himself, who is considered a Celestial-level being,[566] he restrained entire ensembles of the Avengers, the X-Men and the Fantastic Four,[315] and Hulk's ultimate punch at Onslaught quite plausibly could have destroyed the entire universe.[567] Hulk was also portrayed to be too strong, so that Thor Odinson, who was assisted by a group of several heroes, authorized Skaar to fight Hulk but did not dare to defy him directly.[378] The official Marvel website sustains that Hulk is one of the strongest beings ever because his upper strength is potentially limitless. When he was a nexus being, Apocalypse has further declared that the gamma energy provided by Hulk could be employed to prevail even over the Celestials.[50]

Upon performing experiments and measuring the power level of numerous individuals, They Who Wield Power concluded that Hulk is more powerful than countless beings, including Thor and Hercules.[568] According to Kang the Conqueror, Hulk is actually the strongest Avenger, and the gamma-irradiated heart of an alternate reality Hulk endowed a robot based on Hulk with enough raw force to overpower the classic formation of the Avengers.[569] Hulk was likewise recognized as the strongest creature on Earth,[570] and he was similarly described as the most powerful mortal on Earth.[571] In fact, in a canonical scaling Hulk's potential might was established as superior to the collective power of four of the most powerful Avengers.[572] Furthermore, Umar the Unrelenting has even insinuated that the rampaging Hulk alter the Worldbreaker was a potential threat to the universe's plane of existence, presumably referring to domains of reality being destroyed.[381] When this question was raised, Banner even upheld the principle that Hulk was stronger than Hercules,[573] whereas the Thing and Hercules have together proposed that Hulk really was the strongest one there is.[574] Nick Fury's intel has also classified him as Power Level 10+,[575] the highest level of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s scale of measurement, while as the Merged Hulk he was described as a member of the Omega-Class Entities by Doctor Octopus.[576]

Transformation: The process by which Banner usually transforms into the Hulk is presumably the result of the chemical catalyst adrenaline (a.k.a. epinephrine). As in normal human beings, Banner's adrenal medulla secretes large amounts of adrenaline in time of fear, rage, or stress, which hormonally stimulates the heart rate, increases blood-sugar levels, and inhibits sensations of fatigue. Whereas the secretion heightens normal physical abilities in normal human beings, in Banner's case it triggers the complex chemical extra-physical process that transforms him into the Hulk. The total time of the transformation falls anywhere from 25 seconds to five minutes,[544] depending on the initial adrenaline surge, which will be determined by the original stimulus.[544] Soon after the transformation, the amount of adrenaline in Hulk will return to more normal and reduced levels.[544] However, there have been instances in which Banner became the Hulk without any discernible increase in heart rate or adrenal levels, suggesting that the true trigger mechanism that causes Banner to change into Hulk is far more psychological than physical. When Hulk transforms back into Banner, the excess muscle mass and energy is lost, presumably going back to the same place that he derives it from. As Hulk's transformation is mostly a stress reaction, it is virtually impossible to attack, wound or sedate him in his human form without Hulk erupting almost instantaneously in self-defense.[408] As Gamma Mutates and their appearances/abilities are affected by their minds to become "metaphor people",[56] Banner's Hulk form and, to an extent, his abilities constantly change depending on which Hulk/alter is in control. Joe Fixit is weaker but more intelligent and cunning while only coming out at night, Green Scar is full of wrathful fury while being able to erupt with gamma energy, and Devil Hulk is more attuned with the mystical nature of gamma, allowing him to perform seemingly impossible feats like overloading Vibranium, being alive and able to move while dismembered, smelling lies, or seeing into people's souls.

The madder he gets, the stronger he gets!

—Iron Man[source]
  • Unlimited Strength: Hulk possesses the capacity for essentially limitless physical strength. In proportion to his rage, his formidable strength grows geometrically and exponentially towards maximum power.[31][175][577][180][194][400][578][579][568][580][581] Hulk's exceptional physical strength resulted in him being reputed as the world's most powerful being.[224][114][347][551][555] In World War Hulk, his grandiose physical strength was regarded as off the charts by the super-genius Reed Richards.[582] Jack Kirby revealed that, since the conception of the character, he intended Hulk to have unlimited strength.[583] In actuality, though the highest hierarchical challenges mentally imposed by Banner to Hulk may not reflect the real characters' power level, it was implied that Hulk's ultimate potential truly has no limits.[49] Captain America contemplated the fact that confronting Hulk was similar to challenging the Beyonder, as they both had practically infinite power.[290] When pondering about Hulk, Banner personally reinforced that Hulk possesses incalculable strength.[584] Amadeus Cho emphasized that Hulk could have destroyed everyone in the World War Hulk event. So the Olympian goddess Athena then compared this Hulk's sheer, indescribable ferocity and power to that of the Elder God Demogorge.[39] In fact, upon actually estimating Hulk's raw potential, the virtually omniscient cosmic being the Beyonder stated outright that Hulk's strength is intrinsically limitless. Hulk's uttermost potential is indeed infinite, with no finite element inside.[577] This statement has been endorsed by another cosmic being, the Stranger, who deduced that Hulk's capacity for strength is, for all practical purposes, truly unlimited.[194] The knowledgeable Doc Samson has also postulated that Hulk can increase his strength ad infinitum,[290] characterizing him as a child who is endowed with unlimited power,[93] whereas the gamma-spawned genius the Leader has also regularly confessed Hulk's endless strength.[168][170][175] Hulk's boundless strength was further demonstrated by the Mad Thinker's inability to calculate its limits,[400] several experts have effectively failed to determine the precise magnitude of Hulk's brute power,[175][180][579][568] he was designated as one of the strongest beings who has ever lived who is supplied with genuinely inexhaustible power,[585] and his power has been consistently described as immeasurable.[586] Upon annihilating a structure designed to withstand the magnificent power of the Celestials, narration itself described that, ultimately, there is no force stronger than the Incredible Hulk.[587] Hulk's rage, which is the foundation of his unfathomable strength, has also been described as being unlimited.[578][62][63][545] Hulk's reputation extends beyond the planet Earth, with the Skrulls proclaiming him as the strongest mortal on Earth,[588] the alien tyrant Kurrgo the Planet Master stipulating that he is the strongest of all of Earth's creatures,[589] the cosmic wanderer the Silver Surfer recognizing the Incredible Hulk as the strongest mortal that he had ever confronted,[198] and the Supreme Skyfather Odin reflecting that he is the strongest mortal being that Thor Odinson has ever faced.[152] Moreover, the malevolent and massively powerful extradimensional and mystical demon Nightmare has also expressed his fear of trying to exploit Hulk again for his mischievous and wicked ends.[590] However, each of the primary Hulk's personalities possesses a base strength level. While functionally calm, the Gray Hulk persona is the weakest, whereas the incarnation commonly referred to as "Green Scar" is physically the strongest of all of the Hulk's primary incarnations. This is because, after being exposed to the energies from the exploding core of the ship which had originally brought Hulk to Sakaar, Green Scar's base strength level was dramatically increased. Devil Hulk and the Fractured Son are also substantially stronger than most incarnations and presumably rival Green Scar, being capable to effortlessly outclass the combined might of an Avengers team which consisted of powerful heroes,[15] and rupturing chains made from the substance of the primeval cosmic being the First Firmament.[532] However, while in an enraged state, adrenaline surges through Hulk's body, magnifying his extraordinary physical strength drastically beyond its conventional levels. Hulk's astronomical strength is directly proportional to his level of rage, excitement, and stress. Hulk also grows stronger the more gamma radiation[591][120][592][593] and the more dark magic[594][595] that he catalyzes and absorbs. Finally, as Amadeus Cho theorized, Banner subconsciously restrains Hulk's maximum potential because he quantifies and calculates the multiple environmental variables so that Hulk could never hurt innocents. Cho himself corroborated this thesis with a logical analysis of all Hulk's historical conflicts.[596] However, if the suppression of Banner's restrictions occurs, Hulk can neutralize this limitation, such as when he becomes the Worldbreaker.[539] Hulk has also performed impressive feats of strength in his career.
    • Superhuman Leaping: Hulk is able to use his highly developed leg muscles to leap incredible heights and distances. As Hulk becomes enraged, his strength increases considerably, which means he can jump farther than usual. Hulk has transposed about 1,000 miles with a single leap,[597] and in a single leap he jumped on top of Mount Olympus from ground level.[39][598] On more than one occasion, Hulk has nearly jumped into Earth's orbit.[599][12] Hulk even managed to reach Mars' orbit with a single bound.[600] Hulk also shows incredible precision with his ability to aim his jumps and landings. He has grabbed missiles out of the sky on multiple occasions and landed on islands that were barely visible from the height that he fell from.[597] While calm, Hulk's leap has been measured to reach 473 mph.[92]
    • Superhuman Strength Utilizations: Hulk can inhale great quantities of air for several effects. For example, he can expel air at enormous speeds that can knock down forests[601] and armed troops.[129] This resource also enables Hulk to defeat several super-human opponents, such as Mister Fantastic.[602] Hulk can clap his hands together to create a tremendously powerful sonic vibration that propagates through the air and that has been said to put the strongest hurricanes in history to shame.[276] This thunderclap has been powerful enough to disperse the Sandman's attacks,[220] snuff out the Human Torch's flame ability,[560] and severely debilitate the Red Hulk.[538] Hulk can also hit the ground with his hands or legs to create violent tremors that can topple opponents[603] and destroy structures,[235] and is also being able to produce destructive shockwaves just by stomping one foot down hard on the ground.[546] He can also create shockwaves with enough power to shatter glass jars simply by snapping his fingers while possessed by the One Below All.[512]
      • Dimensional Rift Creation (Latent): Hulk's strength is so extreme that if he is enraged enough, he can literally punch holes in the dimensional fabric of the Spacetime Continuum.[54]
Demonstrations of Hulk's strength
  • Hulk both cracked and broke chains that were forged from the First Firmament's essence, a primordial cosmic being who was the original incarnation of the cosmos itself before the Multiverse was created, and was endowed with power on a scale comparable to, or greater than, that of Eternity.[532]
  • Hulk, while he was carrying the Green Flame, traversed a door through sheer raw strength which the Eldest claimed to be impenetrable by any force except the One Above All.[604] This door was made by the One Below All from fragments of the First Firmament, and employed by him to confine the Mother of Horrors herself.[505]
  • With a single thunderclap, Hulk shattered the One Below All, forcing the entity to take time to recover.[56]
  • As eons were passing in seconds due to time dilation at a supermassive black hole, in which Hulk accumulated rage and absorbed gamma energy ultimately proceeding from the One Below All, Hulk demonstrated his infinite potential by damaging and rivaling an average reality level Galactus.[605]
  • A mental duplicate of Hulk, which was a manifestation of sheer rage that was deprived of Banner's psyche and the resulting ability to manipulate the Dream Realm, destroyed Nightmare's realm, the Dream Dimension.[606][607]
  • Hulk's final punch against Onslaught, who had integrated Franklin Richards and X-Man's combined power into himself, overpowered and destroyed his physical form with enough potency to obliterate the entire universe. Also, Onslaught was able to match a collection of highly powerful individuals, including Thor himself.[566][567][315]
  • Before the Starship Hulk, which was fueled by Savage Hulk's rage, received a temporary power-up from Mjolnir, he stalemated an Odinforce-imbued Thor Odinson with and without additional power from gamma energy.[476][478] While imbued with the Odinforce, Thor has been able to exceed the collective power of all the realms spread throughout the known and unknown universe,[479] and even to severely damage Captain America's shield.[608]
  • Hulk contained 1/3 of the power of the Goddess of Night, Nyx, who had previously overpowered the Skyfather Zeus.[609]
  • Hulk destroyed the realm of the Dark Dimension.[610]
  • Hulk vaporized a planet within the Dark Dimension as a side effect of a fight against the Red She-Hulk,[611] and disintegrated the Bi-Beast, Arm'Cheddon, and an enhanced Fin Fang Foom in the process.[539] Arm'Cheddon is durable enough to withstand a full force blast from the Silver Surfer's Power Cosmic.[612]
  • He ruptured the Spacetime Continuum with only one punch in order to stop Zarrko the Tomorrow Man's scheme.[122]
  • He shattered a glass wall that was tempered with Negative Zone particles.[408]
  • Hulk's battle against Thor Odinson threatened to destroy the entire domain of Hela if their combat had not been interrupted,[613] and said domain was a fully-formed universe[614] that encompassed a pan-dimensional Hellish realm[615][616] which infinitely transcended man's universe.[617]
  • The shockwaves from Hulk's collision with Ironclad reached an infinite number of randomly distributed dimensions from all diversity of realities spread throughout the Crossroads nexus, creating tremendous chaos, cataclysmic upheavals and unimaginable destruction.[618]
  • He mated with Umar the Unrelenting, affecting the fabric of space and time on a multicosmic scale propagating from the Dark Dimension and finally reaching man's universe.[619]
  • An alternate variant of Hulk exerted enough strength to keep the Celestial Exitar away from Earth until Iron Man's machinery, designed to channel Hulk's strength, collapsed. In fact, divergent Earths are virtually identical until the point of divergence.[620] Therefore, this Hulk presumably shared the same power level as the Prime Hulk.[621]
  • He mated with Umar the Unrelenting a second time; as their first mating had previously both subtly and almost imperceptibly affected the fabric of space and time on a multicosmic scale, but lasting a shorter period, this was also a similar feat of brute strength.[622]
  • Hulk managed to move in a mystic dimension infinitely more dense than Earth-616's dimension. Doctor Strange reflected that he had never experienced such a kind of dimension before.[517]
  • Upon being drained by the newly devised Celestial Hulkbuster Iron Man Armor that was specially designed for just that purpose, Hulk still generated physical force with potency growing from 100,000 exploding stars.[477]
  • Both supporting himself and standing up despite being pushed down with a weight equivalent to that of a star.[623]
  • Seriously injuring Arm'Cheddon,[381] who had previously overpowered a serious Silver Surfer by redirecting his cosmic rays against himself; while the Troyjan warrior withstood a full force blast from the Silver Surfer's Power Cosmic.[612][381]
  • Matching the bulky top tier incarnation of Drax the Destroyer, whose vast power was further magnified since he was in possession of the Power Gem.[624]
  • Rupturing the Spacetime Continuum with only one punch.[54]
  • He matched mystical energy, whose potency was equivalent to 133 punches from Hercules at maximum force.[625]
  • Pushing two spheres apart, one made of matter and the other of antimatter, and throwing one of them into outer space.[626]
  • Ripping apart an enormous device that was designed to fight against the Celestials.[587]
  • Destroying an asteroid that was twice the size of Earth by being launched towards it and acting as a projectile.[627]
  • Holding together the tectonic plates of a planet to keep it from collapsing.[41]
  • Overpowering a field of energy that was endowed with sufficient power to alter the orbit of a planet.[194]
  • Overpowering greatly enhanced and gigantic incarnations of both the Bi-Beast and the Wendigo.[628]
  • Penetrating a barrier that only Black Bolt's Sonic Scream had penetrated previously.[215]
  • Matching a group of Avengers consisting of the Scarlet Witch before House of M, Wonder Man, Iron Man, and the Vision, while the narration established that Hulk's potential was greater than their combined might.[572]
  • Overpowering a group of several heroes, including Thor and the Thing.[427]
  • While holding back,[539] he stalemated a fully-powered classic Juggernaut.[629]
  • Overpowering the Juggernaut before outside interference changed the course of the battle.[630]
  • He drove Wolverine's claws back into his skull, thus damaging Adamantium with Adamantium.[631]
  • He overpowered a power-draining mechanism which contained much of the combined power of Hulk himself, Doctor Strange, Namor the Sub-Mariner, and the Silver Surfer and which none of the other three aforementioned Defenders could break out of.[632]
  • He tore apart Dracula's Adamantium netting with ease.[388]
  • He charged right through Vector's telekinetic repulsion while he was repelling reality itself.[618]
  • Kang the Conqueror regards Hulk as the strongest Avenger ever, whereas a robot fueled by Hulk's power overpowered the classic formation of the Avengers which was composed of beings such as Thor Odinson and Iron Man.[569]
  • He actually, physically bent the Silver Surfer's surfboard after hitting the Surfer with it.[633]
  • He used his hand to block Thanos's energy blast, and knocked him down with only two punches.[634]
  • He damaged Ultron's Primary Adamantium shell.[65]
  • He demonstrated enough strength to strike down a Chthon-possessed Quicksilver.[635]
  • He crunched and twisted an Adamantium alloy around Blastaar the Living Bomb-Burst, leaving him unable to break out, and threw the resulting sphere into the Mid-Atlantic Ocean.[636]
  • He snapped Adamantium netting with no problem at all.[637]
  • He shattered M.O.D.O.K.'s Adamantium and steel alloy armor just by flexing his muscles.[638]
  • He destroyed the Crypto-Man, even after it had been boosted with physical strength that was superior to that of Thor Odinson.[639]
  • He destroyed the Hammer of Nul.[390]
  • He broke off a coating of solidified Adhesive X that covered his entire body with absolutely no leverage.[640]
  • He performed a thunderclap that destroyed the Dark-Crawler's pocket universe.[234]
  • He shrugged off the combined efforts of Namor the Sub-Mariner and the Silver Surfer to restrain him.[641]
  • He supported a 150-billion-ton mountain that was dropped on him by the Molecule Man.[642]
  • He has both fought, and matched, Thor numerous times.[643][644][645][646][647][15][613]
  • He injured Hercules with only three punches.[355]
  • He overpowered a team of the Avengers consisting of the Vision, the Red Hulk, Wonder Man, Rogue, Thor and Hercules.[648]
  • He matched a 10-times-stronger than normal warrior's madness Thor Odinson and pushed him toward the ground.[649]
  • As the Merged Hulk, he stopped two strikes from Red Norvell's equal duplicate of Mjolnir with only one hand.[650]
  • He applied force to the Spacetime Structure in order to prevent the Defenders from being absorbed into a fissure.[273]
  • As Green Scar, Hulk matched the full power of the Sentry to a stalemate; however, Hulk then briefly reverted to Banner and the Sentry briefly reverted to Bob Reynolds. In their human forms, Banner was able to knock out Reynolds.[358]
  • He brought the Juggernaut to his knees with only two punches.[304]
  • He shattered the Crimson Bands of Cyttorak.[651]
  • He matched the Super-Adaptoid, who had acquired the combined powers of heroes like Iron Man and the Vision.[652]
  • He fractured Thor's skull with only one punch following a severe concussion that left him out of the fight, tore apart the latest Hulkbuster armor that was devised by Iron Man, sent a Celestial-enhanced She-Hulk flying for at least two miles away with only one punch, and overloaded Black Panther's Vibranium-based Panther Habit, which was previously believed to be impossible.[15][653]
  • He matched two Avengers teams during a prolonged period of time in spite of becoming increasingly weaker due to his physical separation from Banner. The two teams consisted of characters such as Hercules, Captain Marvel, Iron Man, Wonder Man, Namor the Sub-Mariner, and the She-Hulk.[549]
  • He overpowered the Invisible Woman, the Thing and the Human Torch,[153] and afterwards fought the combined forces of the Avengers and the Fantastic Four.[154]
  • When the Thing's strength was almost doubled, Hulk still had the upper hand.[589]
  • He easily defeated the Hulkbuster Iron Man.[354][118]
  • He overpowered the combined efforts of Iron Man, Wonder Man, Hercules, and Namor the Sub-Mariner to pin him down, despite having become gradually weakened due to his physical separation from Banner.[545]
  • Subjugating a wet and fully-powered Namor in battle.[654]
  • Overcoming his own strength that was redirected against him.[221]
  • Stopping the Juggernaut's charge[655][629] and crumpling his helmet.[655]
  • Punching away and knocking out the immovable Blob and also punching Unus the Untouchable's Force Field with such force that it hit Unus himself and knocked him out.[656]
  • Picking up and throwing the alien dragon Fin Fang Foom directly to the Moon.[160]
  • Throwing the Soul Gem right through the interior layers of the Microverse world of K'ai and straight into its core.[657]
  • Easily damaging and almost destroying Iron Man's armor.[290]
  • Thor Odinson has admitted that Hulk could be stronger than himself,[647] and that there appears to be no limit to Hulk's strength.[646]
  • Thanos compared Hulk's ever-increasing strength to that of the former Champion of the Universe, Tryco Slatterus, when Tryco was wielding the Power Gem, and said that he had avoided a confrontation with Hulk in the past because of this.[48]
  • When the Leader used one of his inventions, the Kinetron Mitts, as a weapon against Hulk (this device actually reflected the kinetic energy of Hulk's punches back at him, thereby enabling the Leader to beat Hulk with his own power), Hulk's ever-increasing anger was more than enough to first resist them and then both actually crush the mitts with his bare hands while the Leader was still wearing them and tear them from the Leader's hands effortlessly, thus causing his arch-enemy brief but considerable pain.[63]
  • Superhuman Stamina: Hulk's body counteracts fatigue poisons that build up in his muscles during physical activity. In fact, Hulk was capable to leap endlessly during an entire day without showing any signs of fatigue.[153] In an enraged state, Hulk is capable of exerting himself at peak physical capacity for several weeks before fatigue begins to really affect him.[658] However, just like his vast physical strength, Hulk's stamina increases as he becomes angrier.[219][659] In an enraged state, Hulk was able to successfully stalemate the warrior madness Thor,[649] a state which temporarily enhances Thor's strength and stamina to 10 times that of his normal state, but adversely affects his intelligence.[660] A giant robotic Sentinel has calculated Hulk's stamina as almost unlimited.[661] Hulk, while in his Nul, Breaker of Worlds persona, also fought Thor until Thor collapsed on the ground, exhausted.[387]
  • Dynamic Durability: In addition to immense strength, Hulk's body possesses a high degree of resilience to physical injury. The gamma radiation that served as the catalyst for his current state fortified his cellular structure, endowing him with high degree of resistance to injury, pain, and disease.[662] Hulk has survived tremendous amounts of punishment throughout his career. Hulk's skin is impervious to conventional blades, Adamantium and Vibranium being strictly the few known metals that can effectively pierce and penetrate his skin. Hulk was even able to remove Adhesive X from his body without suffering any injury,[640] and to shatter Plasti-Thene, a seemingly indestructible substance that was covering his entire body in a cocoon-like manner, without suffering any harm.[224] This invulnerability also extends to his optic system since bullets,[663] grenade shrapnel,[664] Hawkeye's arrows,[665] and even the Valkyrie's enchanted sword Dragonfang[666] did not penetrate or damage it. Hulk is capable of withstanding high caliber bullets, powerful energy blasts,[667][668][636] pressure extremes, falls from orbital heights,[669][670][671][387][599] maximized heat without burning or blistering, maximized cold without freezing, and also massive impacts. Hulk has withstood several times the impact of ground zero nuclear explosions,[166][254][672][673][674][675] the Human Torch's Nova Blast with a maximum temperature of 1 million degress Fahrenheit,[582][592][425] a full power blow from Mjolnir concentrated in his chest and unleashed by an unrestrained Thor,[560] and also the crushing pressures of 100Gs[175] without suffering any damage or harm. Hulk has even resisted the Vision's phasing abilities,[291][560][572] which have been powerful enough to knock out Hyperion.[676] In fact, when the Maestro's Dog O' War, a robot that was claimed to be able to crush Adamantium in its jaws in 7.3 seconds, had Hulk's exposed neck in its jaws, it was unable to even lacerate his skin before being ripped apart by Hulk.[677] In another monumental example of his durability, Hulk even withstood being subjected to a mechanism that was capable of both softening and manipulating Adamantium easily.[400] Hulk was also able to withstand a planet-devastating impact,[591] a planet-shattering impact at point blank range,[627] the Galaxy Master's strongest planet-destroying attacks,[219] even when their potency was later amplified 10 times,[678] a colossal blow from a Phoenix-empowered Cyclops,[679] phenomenally powerful blows from the extremely powerful Zom-empowered Doctor Strange,[537] and a mighty blast from the Devourer of Worlds Galactus.[680] Hulk even withstood exposure to magical energy calculated as over 100 times more powerful than Hercules' strongest blows,[681] and also the overwhelming pressure and kinetic energy of a literal supernova bursting on his body.[623] Upon being drained by Iron Man while wearing the most recent Celestial Hulkbuster armor created by himself, Hulk withstood extraordinarily powerful blasts whose potency was growing from 100,000 supernovas.[477] In addition, Hulk withstood the Sentry's vastly powerful attacks, which correspond to 1 million supernovas.[359] Hulk even withstood a few of the incredibly powerful blows from Zeus when relatively calm.[598] In a moderately angry state, Hulk was unfazed by the Thing's most potent punch.[263] The full force of Cyclops' optic blasts, estimated by Cyclops himself to be powerful enough to rip a small planet in half,[682] only caused minor damage,[593] while previously his ultimate blast was completely ineffective against Hulk.[667] Furthermore, Hulk has also withstood, on a regular basis, devastatingly powerful blows from godlike beings such as Thor[646][613][649] and Hercules,[39][181][683] or from highly superhumanly powerful beings like the Abomination.[684][685][686] Hulk's durability, in proportion to his strength, is increasingly fueled by rushes of adrenaline while angry.[558][659] This was also exemplified when Wolverine stated during World War Hulk that Hulk's skin was harder to damage,[593] when Hulk withstood a blast from Captain Marvel that was twice as powerful as a blast that had previously harmed him,[687] and when, during a fierce battle against Colossus, Colossus noticed that the harder he hit Hulk, the less it seemed to hurt him.[688] This was further exemplified when both Wolverine's[689] and Black Panther's[690] claws completely failed even to hurt Hulk.
  • Enhanced Breath: Hulk's incredible musculature does not stop at his sinuous extremities; every iota of Banner's gamma-enhanced anatomy has been similarly augmented beyond regular degrees, respiratory facilities included. The Incredible Hulk's lung capacity and oxygen intake sit well beyond the par of the finest human specimen imaginable, easily enabling him to cast gale-force winds from the simple act of breathing hard, being able to knock over dozens of armed guards with a short burst of air,[129] toss aside a bunch of aviary animals on the Microverse world of K'ai,[657] knock over several story tall trees in a lumberyard forest with relative ease, and just as simply disperse poison gas clouds as quick as he can blink.[601][691] Likewise, Hulk's inhalation capacity matches the dynamic force behind his exhalation faculty, once inhaling Reed Richards into his gullet when the latter tried to enwrap and bind him during a slight scuffle,[602] and even ingesting and binding the Hope entity by sucking the ethereal being into himself using his enhanced lung capacity.[692]
  • Retroactive Immortality: To all intents and purposes, Hulk cannot permanently die. The exact nature of this ability is unknown; however, it is suggested that every time Hulk or Banner is killed ever since the day that Banner was hit with the Gamma Bomb, the Green Door is opened and allows him to "walk through" in order to successfully enable Self-Resurrection. It is suggested that it is his other self who walks through, as Banner would rather be at peace than be revived as the Hulk. It was initially theorized that damaging the hypothalamus, an area in the forebrain which controls the nervous system as well as emotions, could effectively kill Hulk, but subsequent resurrections have proven it impossible to prevent a Gamma Mutate's revival, even with their brain completely destroyed.[55][15][433] Following his resurrection by the Challenger,[428] if Banner should die, he would resuscitate by transforming into Hulk at nighttime,[14] although said power was seemingly lost after the Leader was separated from the One Below All, which successfully shut down all of the Green Doors.[53] However, Banner seems to have regained what was lost after having been stabbed in the heart with a cutting knife,[528] with the very embodiment of Death itself stating that he and his counterpart were beyond her reach during a confrontation against Hulk.[693]
    • Self-Sustenance: There were several events in the past where Hulk not only faced extended periods of time in oxygen-deprived environments without suffocating or drowning, he also frequently spoke in these inhospitable habitats such as the Sun's orbit with little difficulty, even while in combat.[270] Either due to the eratic nature of his bodily adjustments or the wildly metaphysical nature of the gamma energy powering it, both Banner and Hulk have shown that they can thrive just about anywhere without any need of nourishment or rest,[218] being able to retain the prime of physical health indefinitely if they so choose.[694]
    • Self-Regeneration Manipulation: As a Gamma Mutate with a connection to the Below-Place, Bruce Banner/Hulk learned that he possessed an autonoetic commandeering of his own recovery rate and extremital prehensility of his individual biomass, as had others in the past,[695] once having been cut into individual pieces and put in a group of several different-sized jars only to compel said pieces to merge back together by sheer force of will.[512]
      • Regenerative Healing Factor: Despite Hulk's high resistance to physical harm, it is possible to cause Hulk injury. However, Hulk is capable of regenerating damaged or destroyed areas of his entire body with much greater speed and efficiency than an ordinary human can. He has demonstrated a vastly superhuman healing capacity, enabling him to regenerate body tissue (including internal organs) within seconds or minutes.[52] In fact, Hulk was able to systematically regenerate all of his internal organs and tissues in an alternate reality.[696] He was also able to rip off a large part of his head, allowing it to regrow completely.[67] In a notorious episode, the Maestro persona molecularly rebuilt his body after being atomized.[121] Hulk also demonstrated his exceptional healing capacity when, during a battle with Vector, all of his skin and most of his muscle mass were extracted from his body. Hulk regained his mass and healed within seconds.[697] Even the Omega-Level biokinetic Elixir's Death Touch could only retard him temporarily.[536] The most extreme depictions of his healing factor also include reintegrating members that are isolated from his body,[512] and reconstructing his body ater being pulverized at a subatomic level by the titanic forces of a supermassive black hole.[605] Hulk's regenerative healing factor also enables him to resist physical transmutations.[698][699][700][276][593] Additionally, Hulk heals faster and more extensively the angrier he gets.[659] For example, the Scorpion (Carmilla Black) once injected into Hulk's body a chemical substance that counteracted his healing factor. Amadeus Cho then caused Hulk to get enraged enough for his immune system to repel the substance.[596] Combined with Hulk's superhuman durability, it makes him exceedingly difficult to defeat or incapacitate, as noted by Wolverine during their second battle.[659]
        • Disease Immunity: Hulk is completely immune to all known Earth-based diseases, bacteria and viruses, including AIDS.[300][701] When what Sentry believed to be some kind of crystalline virus began infecting many, including Hulk, Hulk was not affected in the same way that many others were. Sentry stated that Hulk's unique body chemistry made his immune system strong enough to reject it.[702] He can operate under intense conditions for prolonged periods of time due to his body not developing fatigue toxins quickly.
        • Decelerated Aging: To all intents and purposes; Hulk lives indefinitely. Because of an enhanced healing factor derived from the properties of the gamma energy that empowers him, Hulk has a prolonged lifespan. A persona from a possible alternate future, the Maestro, was in his physical prime despite being over 100 years old.[307] In another possible alternate future, it is implied that Hulk's entire body effectively lasts forever,[696] which was further proven when both another alternate future's Banner and its Mister Immortal were seen as the only two beings that were left alive to witness the end of the universe.[73]
      • Body Part Autonomy: In spite of his nervous system being badly dissociated, Banner/Hulk can willingly control each of his individual body parts as if they were still part of his uniformly whole physiology, even being able to operate his appendages and command his internal organs to move and act according to his will if he so chooses.[512]
  • Superhuman Speed: Regardless of his size, Hulk's superhumanly strong legs allow him to run at speeds that are well beyond the natural physical limits of even the finest human athlete. In fact, Hulk's speed is so relatively high that, while tunneling underground from Subterranea to California, the Avengers feared that Hulk could fracture the San Andreas Fault in a matter of a few hours.[236] In an excellent display of increased velocity, Hulk easily outperformed an aircraft while on land,[123] and in another astonishing demonstration of ground speed, Hulk crossed a vast distance encompassing several states in a matter of instants.[634] Hulk's gigantic speed extends to his leaps, which allowed him to pursue and reach a space missile.[12] Hulk also possesses immense swimming speeds as well. He has been clocked to be swimming at 80 knots,[597] and has even matched Namor the Sub-Mariner's underwater speed,[225] even while Namor was moving quickly enough to create a whirlpool, much to the Atlantean king's surprise.[205] Referring to Hulk's formidable speed, Banner pondered that Hulk is able to run at eye-blurring speeds and to swim fast enough to actually build propulsion.[124]
    • Superhuman Agility: Hulk has also eventually been recognized to be extremely agile in proportion to his size.[130][153][178][254][545][703] His Green Scar persona being adroit and adept enough to outmaneuver the Red King of Sakkar in his power armor during arena combat.[7]
      • Superhuman Reflexes: Hulk has been fast enough to capture or intercept mortar shells and missiles shot at him.[154][704][705][706][707] In point of fact, his reactions standing equally as spectacular have even been described as "lightning-fast reflexes",[708][268] being quick enough to enable him to snatch a speeding hoverflier out from mid-air,[709] as easily as intercepting an Adamantium clawed sneak attack with an open palm from Logan when after the two finished off a Wendigo.[689] More examples of Hulk's prodigious combat reactions include easily catching Captain America's shield throw,[710][665] plucking an arrow with his bare hand that was shot by Hawkeye,[711] zeroing Iron Man after he departed and grabbing him in mid-air,[712] hitting Quicksilver while he was running at high speeds,[713][714] and both pursuing and touching the Silver Surfer while the Surfer was maneuvering at supersonic speeds.[197] Hulk, while holding back tremendously against physically inferior opponents, has managed to hit both Daredevil despite his heightened radar-senses and extraordinary response time[715] and Spider-Man despite his spider-sense and remarkable reflexes.[716][717][718] Furthermore, Hulk has easily dodged bullets and missiles shot from close range,[128][241][719][720] has effortlessly captured a bullet in his teeth in mid-transformation,[721] and has regularly matched beings with virtually unparalleled combat speed such as Gladiator,[722] the Sentry,[359] and the Silver Surfer.[668] Hulk has also hit several speedsters, who were operating in an accelerated time flow, before they could react.[723]
  • Self-Adaptation (Latent): Recent chapters in Banner's life have revealed that his ability to modify his personal anatomy to survive and adjust to immediate stimuli can be influenced by his force of will. When the Leader had infiltrated Hulk's consciousness through his Green Scar/Worldbreaker persona, he had opted that Hulk alter to remake Hulk's bone structure to facilitate his own Sakarran gladiator armguard by growing skeletal protrusions that turned into knuckle spikes just as he punched Xemnu the Living Titan clear into oblivion.[454]
    • Reactive Adaptation: It was long theorized by a Life Model Decoy of Nick Fury that Hulk could adapt to the environment of outer space as an inherent property of his mutation. He based this thesis on accumulated data about Hulk.[724] For example, Hulk can harmonize his biological structure with the depths of the ocean.[725] The LMD of Fury's hypothesis has been confirmed, since it was stated that Hulk can adapt to any environment, even airless space;[726] therefore, this proves that Hulk could adapt to a wide diversity of hostile habitats. It is plausible that this ability is enhanced and amplified by Hulk's anger. Accordingly, it has also been stated that Hulk does not always need to breathe.[408]
      • Underwater Breathing: Hulk has been on the ocean floor a number of times. Hulk is able to breathe due to his body developing a gland which creates an oxygenated perfluorocarbon emulsion which fills his lungs and equalizes the pressure.[245][256] He is, therefore, able to both breathe fluid and avoid decompression and nitrogen narcosis.
    • Adaptive Attribute Assimilation (Latent): Hulk has the underlying prospect of taking on whatever force he is faced with to further bolster his considerable strength. Having once battled the U-Foes while at his absolute weakest, his Joe Fixit persona somehow used this facility to assimilate the cosmological force directed at him by X-Ray, which left him a half-melted cadaver. He later revived as a new version of Red Hulk, one that was powerful enough to smash apart Red Doors, which normally inhibit a Gamma Mutate's ability to resurrect from the dead.[727]
      • Cosmic Energy Channeling: When being saturated with cosmic radiation courtesy of X-Ray, one of the U-Foes, Sunshine Joe Fixit somehow enabled himself, and by extension their Hulk form, to assimilate the cosmic energy with their gamma energy in order to become an all-new Hulk/Red Hulk hybridization of some sort, becoming vastly more powerful than ever before in the process.[74]
  • Telepathic Resistance: In many instances, Hulk has demonstrated great psychic resilience as a side effect of his innate rage and the multiple personalities that are inside his mind.[194][728][729][730][731][536] When in ideal conditions, it is extremely difficult to enslave Hulk mentally. In parallel, this ability increases with his rage. This was demonstrated when Psyklop managed to initially enthrall Hulk with his hypnotic powers, but was not able to subjugate a truly enraged Hulk at all.[728] In an example of his mental prowess, Hulk was even able to survive using the Ultimate Machine, which contained the collective knowledge of an entire universe. While the Leader died, despite his heightened intellect, due to being unable to process the entirety of the information and having his brain overloaded, Hulk was able to survive after using it to find out that Rick was in danger, after which he removed the device and leaped away.[732] In an astounding exhibition of his psionic fortitude, Hulk proved to be unaffected by Xemnu the Living Titan's telepathic assault,[518] which has been powerful enough to mesmerize the entire human population,[733] put a mental block on Doctor Strange to prevent him from using his powers,[730] or even engage the enormously powerful Moondragon in battle.[734] Hulk was also the only one who was able to remember the Sentry after the Sentry had used his psionic powers to remove his memories from everyone on the planet, while highly powerful psychics such as Professor X could only utilize their psionic powers to find out that their memories had been radically altered and twisted.[735] Hulk has withstood telepathic attacks from the Stranger,[194] the Shaper of Worlds,[265] Charles Xavier,[536] Selene,[736] Doctor Strange,[356] the Leader,[230] Mentallo,[98] the Ringmaster,[737] etc.
  • Extrasensory Perception:
    • Astral Form Perception: Hulk has the unique ability of being able to see astral forms or ghosts,[738] and even physically interact with them.[739] This power has come in handy when working with his fellow Defender Doctor Strange, who is able to leave his body in an usually invisible ghost-like state that is better known as an astral form. Banner subconsciously feared that his father's ghost would come back to haunt him, and so Hulk developed this mechanism in order to allow him to look out for him. More recent events have shown that the power to see astral forms may now extend to Banner as well; however, it was suggested that the clarity of the astral forms that Banner sees is diminished when compared to Hulk's ability to see them. Hulk's ability to see astral forms may go beyond just seeing individual spirits. Hulk once saw an entire town in the middle of the American desert that then faded away into nothing. While it is possible that it was merely a mirage, it is also possible Hulk was able to see a town that did not exist in our plane of reality that no-one else could see.
    • Clairsentience: The advent of Devil Hulk's resurgence gave Banner an uncanny intuitive capacity for taking subconscious steps towards the right direction when looking for the object or item of his desires,[436] suspecting that his newfound Devil Hulk persona had come to act as the back-up brains of the outfit, seeing as Banner's considerable genius-level intellect had become clouded upon his resurrection.
    • Homing Ability: Hulk also has a seemingly mystical homing ability that enables him to locate the area in New Mexico where Banner first became the Hulk.[285] This applies even if Hulk is in another dimension. An image of the Maestro once explained to Banner that the reason that he was able to do this was because the Maestro's spirit was there, calling to him.[121] However, since the time that the Maestro was resurrected, Hulk has still continued to return to the Gamma Bomb test site, suggesting that there is more to this ability than merely the Maestro's spirit. This homing ability has also been used to find people on rare occasions. For example, Hulk was able to dig a tunnel underground exactly in the direction of Onslaught.[740] While it is possible that Onslaught was mentally guiding Hulk to him, there were other instances of Hulk demonstrating this ability. Hulk's instincts led him to Betty[741] and Rick,[742] and Hulk located the Abomination with no prior knowledge of his whereabouts.[684] Hulk was also able to know that the Vision was approaching while inside an underground tunnel, even though he could neither see nor hear the intangible Avenger's approach.[236]
    • Clairalience: Devil Hulk had showcased some odd Inoderous affect whence after his and Banner's resurrection, Even Thor Odinson felt a chill run up and down his being, as he could feel that Hulk's olfactory range had expanded beyond the purely physical realm.[15]
      • Veracity Sensing: One of the new sensorial inputs which Immortal Hulk has mentioned to've obtained, is how he can intuit when someone is lying through an as of yet unknown means.[743]
  • Freedom: Because of the precarious nature of his gamma-fueled personages Banner / Hulk exists, by the vernacular of Thanos, "outside of the norm", much like Thanos does himself,[744] being a creature of mysterious constitution even with the oddity of a concept in and of itself that breaks all known laws of physics, much less reality. It seemingly explains all of the impossible things that Hulk is capable of doing with mere brute strength alone. Such qualities could even be transferred among other waiting hosts, should they be willing and waiting on the chance to exploit such a unique precarious aspect of the Jade Giant.[745] These attributes seemingly tie in with how wherever Hulk goes, the world changes to match or follow suit right beside him,[477][449] from the people he interacts with to the very environments he comes across in his storied travels.[47][481] This trait of his could be what makes him impartial to the constants of Life and Death, as the latter's embodiment openly called both Banner and Hulk "He Who Eludes My Grasp", meaning that he has transcended the concept of mortality as he has all other ruling elements of the universe.[693] Other such corroborating evidence comes from the bitterly covetous Eldest's mother, Vinruviel the Mother of Horrors, who asks why is it that Hulk, and only Hulk, can unseal the gates which bind her progenitor behind the Green Door's ancient seal, even after she had received all the amalgamated powers of various Gamma Mutates that Eldest had bound and tethered to a Midwife of Arachnis, which spawned a cadaverous shell of the body of the Abomination for her to possess.[746]
    • Medium Awareness: Banner as Hulk seemingly possesses an uncanny understanding of his fictional existence, meaning that he can both see and interact with the medium his stories are told in to some degree, having once used this to track down Gwenpool while the two of them fought one another across comic mediums.[747]
      • Limited Medium Interaction: While battling Gwenpool, Hulk somehow duplicated, or learned how to duplicate, her ability to perceive and interact with the cordoning mediums of the fictional world's paneling which allowed her to commandeer the comic brackets in which characters of fiction dwell, somehow seeing and latching onto her ankle from lettering and caption boxes and both touching and even breaking through panel gutters, allowing her to transport objects short distances from a completely different scene box, just so that he can slam her into the ground.[747]
  • Musculature/Lateral Repulsion/Momentum Flight (Semi-Latent): In his earliest appearances, Hulk possessed the ability to fly under his own power.[127] The mechanism behind such phenomena is largely unknown, but one could presume that Hulk's gamma-irradiated muscles played a hand in it, as he had once been flung a great distance by the Leader's Humanoids and missed crashing through a bridge structure simply by flexing a bit to defy gravity and to angle himself over it.[167] Another time when Hulk attained flight was when Banner had converted Hulk's body into a Celestial Tech-saddled vessel his human consciousness could pilot throughout the Multiverse,[748] a combination of magic-tech engine thrust fueled by the chassis' own gamma emissions and Savage Hulk's infinite anger.[473] Titan showed that he has even greater control over this power than even the Starship Hulk, being jettisoned off Hulk Planet by his adversary in Monolith, only to immediately re-position himself and fly back to the battlefield using the soles of his feet for thrust in order to return to the fight, post-haste.[484] Following a period at the center of a supermassive black hole, Hulk could also traverse the universe in order to find Galactus after incorporating massive amounts of gamma energy and adjusting his body to the lower pressure environment outside said black hole.[605]
  • Supernatural Genetics (Latent): Every iota of the several quadrillion blood cells, muscle fibers, bodily fluids, and other assorted flesh and sinews coursing within Banner's frame enables him a litany of extra otherworldly abilities.[107] Primarily, his sanguine elements can transfer his gamma mutagenic condition to others, provided they receive a direct infusion of which, either through biophysical transplants or lipid transfusions.[749] It also has enriching or restorative properties when it comes in contact with herborial life, having both propagated the growth of foliage to incredible degrees to the point of replanting barren planets that are completely devoid of plant life.[32]
    • Subsuming Transplantation: Another pointed-out element regarding this facet of Hulk is that, whether it is by blood or radiation exposure, it does not just beget the powers that are typically found in most Gamma Mutates, but direct infusions from Banner / Hulk's specific mutate chain transfers, an inheritance of certain psychological and emotional qualities that belonged to the donor.[449] In the case of Jennifer Walters, she would later be a host of an alternate She-Hulk persona,[750] and in that of Amadeus Cho, he would gain a Dark Hulk persona which embodied some of his more negative impulses that he had originally repressed.[751] The same could also be said of Dr. Leonard Samson, who purportedly developed dissociative personas during his time with the Intelligencia that caused his base physique to fluctuate in potency.[752]
  • Gamma Radiation/Energy Manipulation, Absorption and Emission: This is not usually a power that is normally associated with Hulk, but there is enough evidence that Hulk possesses at least a limited ability to manipulate forms of energy, particularly gamma radiation. Hulk's body works like a "gamma battery" by constantly creating and radiating gamma energy.[208] The Troyjan emperor Arm'Cheddon once wanted to employ Hulk's own gamma radiation to power machines that would resurrect his son, Trauma, from the dead; however, Hulk outsmarted him by consciously force-feeding his energy into these machines at a rate that was too fast for them to handle, and they promptly overloaded and exploded.[753] Hulk also generated massive amounts of gamma radiation during the World War Hulk story arc,[359] and produced a considerable quantity while in the Dark Dimension.[539] Hulk has also shown the ability to redirect gamma rays that are unleashed toward him. When the Avengers used the Gammatron Bombarder on him, Hulk deflected the blast at the device and destroyed it.[236] During his second battle with the Galaxy Master, Hulk resisted and reflected his enemy's "gamma bombardment" attacks and further demonstrated a beam-shaped projection of gamma energy by using the accumulated gamma energy within himself against the alien entity.[678] Hulk is also able to absorb gamma energy. As Banner, he absorbed the tremendous amount of energy that was stored aboard the Intelligencia's Helicarrier.[377] As Hulk, he has demonstrated the ability to absorb different forms of radiation as he drained the energy of a Kiber Fusion reactor into himself, which had the radical effect of causing his gamma levels to rise completely out of his control, both boiling and nearly causing the ocean line of Kenya, if not a good third of the world's major oceans, to catch fire,[754] and has even siphoned the gamma energy from the second Red Hulk,[430] Sasquatch,[436] and Rebecca Green.[755] The exact extent to which Hulk controls his own gamma radiation, and also extrinsic sources of other radiative forms, has yet to be established.
    • Infection: It had long been theorized that the quasi-mystical nature of gamma rays had more to them than simply a mere biophysical transition and DNA / psyche graft impartment factor.[439] Jennifer Walters, a cousin of Banner's and also the Gamma Mutate named She-Hulk, had an eerie feeling that every time the Avengers or other super-powered characters came in contact with Hulk, the original Gamma Mutate, all of them came under the influence of his gamma radiation, as if Hulk was somehow affecting their moods with his own rage,[463] believing that it was the reason that old partners often always came to blows, seemingly without rhyme or reason, despite Hulk's long and storied history both as a hero and as an ally to various costumed adventurers,[465] a trait that was proven to hold some weight, as a recent persona named Titan had shown that he was able to somehow take hold of those that he had infected with Hulk's emissions and enthrall them to his will in El Paso, Texas.[470]
    • Size Increase: Through the intake of excess gamma radiation, Hulk once managed to absorb the radiation of several nuclear bombs, which made him grow to a monumental size up to the point where he became much larger than even Fin Fang Foom was.[610] Other variants of Banner's psyche which manifest through his transformations can also greatly deviate how large Hulk's physical frame can become, such as when he had transformed from Gray Hulk into his Green Hulk alters, or how he had changed into either Kluh or Titan.[36] His heaving body frame only further increases in size and mass to extraordinary degrees.[49]
    • Anti-Magic (Latent): The nature of gamma thrives upon, and produces, its own kirbons; particle minutia which possess magic-cancelling effectivity to them.[756] It is a little-known fact that gamma rays can generate these particles, through which Hulk can repulse and deflect most forms of magical arcana that are used against him.[757]
    • Optic Blasts: After the malevolent persona named Titan took control of the Hulk persona that was about to fight the Abominations, Titan increased Hulk's anger to such a level that he could fire blasts of energy from his eyes.[758] Even after Titan lost control, Hulk was still able to fire blasts of energy from his eyes.[477]
    • Physical Augmentation: In the same manner that Titan persona could suborn and enthrall others with just a tinge of his radiology, he could also beef up an un-transformed Banner enough to both rip into flesh and tear through muscle with his bare hands.[470]
    • Mass Consciousness (Latent): This is a more irregular aspect of Hulk's power spectrum in the same vein that the Titan persona can remotely possess those who come under the influence of gamma.[470] Banner can potentially overshadow numerous hosts using his gamma radiation emissions, and it is not even living organisms that he is limited to possessing, considering that an inkling of the Titan persona remained within his Asgardian armor that was garnered from when the Starship Hulk withheld Thor's hammer, Mjolnir.[479]
    • Power Sourcing: As the original Gamma Mutate and the avatar of the One Below All, the metaphysical source of limitless gamma radiation, Hulk stands as his own walking, talking, breathing gamma battery that never runs low on energy.[753][180] As such, the Green Goliath can never burn out his internal gamma power, as it is fueled by his rage. By extension, the radiation that he can dish out is also inexhaustible.[359][180] Hulk's internalized reactor can also be used to fuel powerful spells and/or highly intricate technologies,[539] such as the time when Psyklop sought to use a miniaturized Hulk to energize a summoning ritual in order to summon his Dark Gods to Earth.[249][250] Moreover, Galactus employing the Power Cosmic was unable to extract Hulk's full energy after Hulk had integrated into himself gamma energy ultimately proceeding from the One Below All.[605] Hulk could also cleverly utilize this aspect of his physiology to overload a Kree energy siphoning device called the Starwheel when the Kree tried to drain the energies of both himself and his fellow Defenders.[632]
  • Divine Being-Killing (Semi-Latent): An oddity of Hulk's ever alternating physiognomy that stands as an infrequent ability that enables him to challenge and kill supreme entities, something which did not present itself until after the resurgence of certain alters in their shared psyche, such as the time when Devil Hulk outright murdered the God of Sleep, Hypnos, by crushing his neck,[759] and another time when the Fractured Son went on a tear as an eldritch horror slayer who could kill multiversal cataclysm-inducing entities using only sheer brute force.[760]
  • Fear Inducement (Semi-Latent): After Devil Hulk had asserted itself after decades of dormancy, Banner gained a proclivity to instill fear within all whom he came across on an almost esoteric level.[630] Hulk had always possessed a propensity to inherently terrify all those around him,[761] but after his most expedient resurrection, the Green Goliath could now evoke terror in the face of monsters and even gods themselves,[759] a dread so deep that even the spawns of ancient principalities are loath to face it directly.[762]
  • Existential Pathology (Latent): An underlying power that Hulk possesses, which is unique to his gamma-powered constitution, is to effectuate and deviate anything and everything that comes in contact with his mystically irradiated essence and viscera, that being his blood or the gamma radiation that he emits from his entire body. In sanguine form, he can cause metaphysical transformations in a waiting host that imprints his odd physiological characteristics onto others to some odd extents.[763][749] In more extreme cases, this can also have an immediate effect on plants, animals and fungi in some odd respects.[32][112] If a more powerful incarnation of the Hulk were so inclined, Banner could potentially accelerate and take control of growth and development in the environment around him and have the very elements themselves bend and twist into new forms of myriad entities at his will,[764] having once let out such a huge burst of gamma radiation on a distant world universes away to such extremes that it somehow augmented the physical and mental capacities of a host of Gamma Mutates from another reality to new heights, granting them Hypercognitive sapience.[481]

Abilities

  • Super-Genius Intelligence: Dr. Robert Bruce Banner is a super-genius in nuclear physics,[765] possessing a mind so brilliant that it cannot be measured by any known intelligence test;[91] hence, he is capable of extraordinary feats of intellect such as to successfully reprogram an advanced and especially sophisticated computer system (that was intended to be used to rule the world)[766] in a matter of seconds.[767] In effect, Banner even accomplished infecting a computer system with a virus that even Tony Stark, employing all of his skills, was unable to counteract.[768] Banner is regarded by Stark as the most brilliant nuclear scientist (presumably on the planet),[263] and another description corroborates Stark's statement upon indicating that Banner is the greatest nuclear scientist in the world.[224] Banner also has expertise in several additional fields, such as biology,[769] engineering,[770] and architecture.[771] Banner was referred as the only true expert on radiation-based mutation.[772] He was once estimated as the fourth smartest person on the planet,[370] Black Panther categorized him as one of the smartest beings in the universe,[487] Doctor Doom considers him a genius unparalleled in certain fields,[253] Nick Fury reveres Banner's intellect as belonging to the same class as Reed Richards and Tony Stark,[575] the High Evolutionary reputed Banner as the only one in the world that was able to help him to terminate his own life,[699] M.O.D.O.K. highly esteemed Banner by deeming him as the greatest threat among the eight smartest persons,[374] and even Reed Richards recognized him as one of the most intelligent persons on the entire planet.[372] This view is reiterated by Tony Stark, who acknowledges Banner as one of the smartest persons in the world.[574] Bruce has three doctorates.[773]
  • Master Combatant: Hulk is a skillful and capable warrior, demonstrating vast versatility and intuition in the battle, like anticipating and exploiting the weakness of Hyperion,[774] defeating Mister Fantastic by inhaling and spitting out his malleable body after being enveloped by it,[602] and also utilizing the Blob's immobility against him.[775][738] Hulk has consistently faced warriors with ample experience in combat, such as Thor,[644][645][649] Skurge the Executioner,[179][207] and Hercules.[181][683][39] As Green Scar, he has had training in multiple combat arms, including broadswords, spears, and battle shields.[47] As Doc Green, he received martial arts training from the master martial artist Iron Fist.[413]
  • Indomitable Will: Hulk has an enduring and unbreakable will power under extreme conditions. If his loved ones are threatened or the battle is so heated that it requires his dynamic strength to be explored further, he will strive to subdue his foes no matter how powerful they are or how uneven the odds are. On one occasion, when the Defenders were captured and imprisoned in power-draining machinery, Hulk was the only one capable of both unearthing an unfathomable hidden will power and increasing his strength sufficiently enough to destroy the machinery and save everyone.[632] In a fierce battle against the Abomination, despite being initially overwhelmed by the superior might of Abomination, once Betty Ross was threatened his strength grew dramatically enough to overpower his enemy.[580] In yet another battle against Abomination, Abomination's strength was restored to its original levels by the Galaxy Master. Despite being initially subjugated, Hulk's strength remarkably increased, ensuring his victory.[678]
  • Self-Restraint: When Banner is the Hulk, he can influence Hulk's behavior to a limited extent. However, several facts indicate that Banner subconsciously restrains the Hulk.[315][596][539][39][685] For example, the Merged Hulk asked for Jean Grey to psionically shut Banner off so that Hulk's sheer power could be unleashed against Onslaught.[315] In addition, the Worldbreaker alter represents the complete withdrawal of Banner's usual restraints.[539] Moreover, Hulk has further stated that Banner's constraints prevent Hulk from destroying Earth.[685] In another occasion, Iron Man has also deduced that Banner exerts a moderating influence on the Hulk,[545] and he even declared that Hulk normally represses and regulates the potency of all his punches.[139] In a classic combat between Thor and Hulk, at one point it was narrated that Banner was suppressed, though Banner's dominion over the Hulk in this issue had been unstable.[646] Doc Samson has further pondered that, while extensive destruction has been caused by Hulk, he has never killed a single soul while confronting the Army.[776] Devil Hulk even recognized that Amadeus Cho's hypothesis about Banner exercising subconscious control on Hulk is plausible, although it works only for the other classic incarnations of the Green Goliath.[72] In a dialogue with Ben Grimm, Gray Hulk revealed to him that Savage Hulk never killed the Thing during any of their battles because he was withholding the full expression of his power.[777] Banner has further disclosed to Wolverine and Daken that Savage Hulk, in spite of his relentless fury, never killed anyone during his rampages.[369]
  • In order to spare the civilians who were inside a building, Banner's subconscious influence oriented the Hulk to concentrate his battle against the Sandman outside said building.[245] Upon being subjected to Nightmare's machinations, Hulk also aroused his uncontrollable inner savagery, revealing that Banner had lost ascendancy over the Hulk and ultimately resulting in Banner's "psychic suicide."[283] In yet another instance, Professor X, before an imminent confrontation between Hulk and the X-Men, also scanned Hulk's mind and discovered that Banner was in control and that the Hulk posed no threat, which was soon confirmed by the team.[778] In fact, Banner has even stimulated the Hulk to hit the time barrier with the maximum strength that he had ever demonstrated, suggesting that Banner had never allowed Hulk to exert so much strength before.[122] During a battle against Thor and Iron Man, Banner also stipulated that since Hulk thought that he was in a simulation, he would not hold back, which manifests again that the Hulk usually restrains his power.[477] Banner has similarly declared to Odin that Hulk would not release his full might against a psychotic gamma-empowered Thor in order to not unleash the maleficent Titan persona.[478] In addition, the Merged Hulk has ensured that he was holding back in a previous clash with Doctor Octopus in which he was defeated, and vindicated this claim by effortlessly demolishing Octopus.[779]
  • Multilingual: Banner learned Russian while getting his Ph.D.[729] He also speaks Austro-Bavarian[767] and Spanish[529].
  • Fencing
  • Strategist

Weaknesses

Besides regular frailties, Banner no longer has any of Hulk's weaknesses.[780]

Former Weaknesses
  • Gamma Radiation Draining: Hulk is sometimes portrayed as vulnerable to gamma radiation draining by sufficiently powerful energy manipulators.[781][782] Reverting to human form may be necessary for Hulk to recharge his gamma energy.[783] However, Hulk is characterized as possessing immunity to the complete removal of his gamma energy.[784] For example, the mutant Darwin employing his ability to adapt was unable to drain his gamma radiation,[629] and Hulk deliberately transferred his energy into an entire race of absorbing entities without even collapsing.[26] Also, Konrad Zaxon's highly developed equipment was unable to measure Hulk's gamma energy,[180] the Spaceknight Rom was completely unable to cure Banner of his condition,[785] the Kree's advanced machinery could not assimilate Hulk's full energy,[632] whereas Hulk intentionally overloaded the Armageddon's absorption mechanism.[753] Finally, Galactus employing the Power Cosmic was unable to extract Hulk's full energy.[605]
  • Gas Inhalation: Great doses of gas can temporarily neutralize Hulk;[640][259][219] however, it is not an insurmountable obstacle, since Hulk can dissipate the gas with a powerful thunderclap, destabilizing his opponent with the resulting shockwaves.[786][647] Hulk has also occasionally resisted this weakness.[787]
  • Adamantium and Vibranium Blades: These two metals have been shown to be capable of actually, physically piercing Hulk's skin; Wolverine, X-23, and Black Panther's claws can pierce it.[536][629] However, as Hulk's rage increases they become progressively less effective, finally reaching a stage where they are completely unable to hurt him.[788][689][690]
  • Cosmic Radiation: Cosmic radiation is the "opposite" of gamma radiation.[789][53] X-Ray has used this fact to weaken Hulk or even transform him back into Banner.[708][789] The U-Foes once even killed Hulk with these "anti-gamma" rays and sent him to the Below-Place, but they made the mistake of constantly feeding him cosmic rays. The cosmic rays then seeped into the Below-Place, got absorbed by Joe Fixit, and turned him into a new version of Red Hulk. Red Hulk then smashed his way through the Red Door that was keeping him in the Below-Place and Hulk was resurrected from the dead, empowered by the cosmic rays.[75]
  • Adrenaline Suppression: Adrenaline inhibitors can be administered via syringes of Adamantium and Vibranium, aiming to revert the transformation. Amplified quantities can accomplish this purpose.[790] However, Hulk has also withstood substances intended to sedate him by tactile contact.[791]
  • Toxic Substances: Once, the Scorpion (Carmilla Black) injected Hulk with a toxin especially designed to counteract the efficiency of his healing factor; however, if Hulk gets angry enough, he can nullify this effect, as he quickly demonstrated.[596]
  • Rage Nullification: Hulk's rage can also be neutralized; certain individuals can calm Hulk down. Betty Ross[251] and the Sentry[133] have successfully calmed Hulk down on several occasions. Telepaths with vast empathy potential can theoretically emulate this effect. The Inhuman Randall Jessup's ability to siphon away negative emotions makes him a particularly effective deterrent to Hulk's rage factor.[792]
  • Strength Increasing Factor: Hulk normally does not achieve high-end strength in the first moments after his transformation.[189] Unless there is a substantial and significant event that breaks Banner's restraints and triggers far superior amounts of adrenaline in his circulatory system, Hulk struggles to achieve extreme power levels and can theoretically be defeated in the earlier stages of the transformation. His strength level at any given moment may still be inferior to that of his opponents.
  • Subversion of Personas: Every now and again, Banner and the Hulk often come to adversarial terms with one another, either side of the fence threatening to overtake their opposite number for the sole occupation of their shared being.[526]
  • Magic: Since Hulk is empowered by dark magic,[595][594] this is not properly a weakness. However, depending on Hulk's emotional state, his incarnation, and the power magnitude of the magic manipulator, this could be a potential threat.[206][207][598] However, Hulk has also been shown to be injured more easily by enchanted weapons than by regular weapons.[80]
  • Special Conditions: Hulk can be hurt or killed by cosmic beings and individuals with similar extraordinary levels of power. Under some conditions, he is more susceptible to mental manipulation by exceptionally powerful telepaths. In this context, the psionic control efficiency is inversely proportional to Hulk's rage level.[728][737]
  • Ultraviolet Radiation: Due to the nature of Devil Hulk, Banner is now vulnerable to concentrated ultraviolet radiation, which nullifies his Hulk transformation and reverts him back to his human form.[15][793][448] He was eventually able to overcome this weakness by working with Devil Hulk.[451]

Paraphernalia

Equipment

  • BannerTech PDA: Banner has a mobile operating system that can hack sophisticated systems within moments and seems to be controlled mentally for the most part.
  • BannerTech Shield/Gamma Dome Generator: Banner has created a gamma- and Old Power-fueled shield that protects him from most physical harm. It has been shown to protect him from beings as strong as Skarr and the Juggernaut. Banner is able to extend this shield to cover several other people and also redirect the energy in order to increase his strength.
  • BannerTech Satchel: Banner has a pocket teleporter in his satchel with which he can reach into it and grab things from his lab.
  • BannerTech Wrist-Watch Teleporter: A pocket-sized teleportation device that Banner can spontaneously warp himself and others across vast distances with.
  • A molecular repulsion field that could be used to simulate levitation.
  • A miniature electromagnetic pulse blast.
  • BannerTech Nanoparticulates: microrobotic particles that are able to hack and disable technological weapons.
  • BannerTech Flyspy Cams: a spybot with hosts of scanners that are constantly performing advanced diagnostics on everyone within 50 feet of him; he also uses them to carry out thorough bioscans of a particular set of individuals under his surveillance.
  • Banner used to sew a survival kit into his pants so that whenever he awakened, he could survive anywhere. The kit included a needle and thread, a pack of waterproof matches, and a debit card.[645]
  • After joining S.H.I.E.L.D., Banner was able to build new technologies to help mankind:
    • Banner has created a purification unit that could prevent all waterborne disasters for the next five years.[400]
    • Banner has made the catalytic converter, which could save countless people from smoking-induced cancers.[794]
    • Banner has designed a suit of his own, but its maximum capabilities are unknown.[794] Since, unlike Hulk, Banner cannot breathe underwater, the suit enables Banner to breathe in oxygenless environments.[795] The suit also allows him to survive absolute zero temperatures.[796]
    • Banner also has constructed a contact lens which allows him to operate it like a computer. Using this, he can monitor his vital functions.[400]
Former Equipment
  • Banner took control of the Hulk by using technology that was stolen from A.I.M.[471] to fracture his psyche into parts. The technology was fitted over Hulk-like armor. The armor has a jetpack that allowed Hulk to fly[474] and energy weapons for defense.[470] It could also reassemble and repair itself if damaged.[49] Banner lost these cybernetics after taking back control of his body from the Titan persona.[484]

Weapons

  • Old Power Taser: a stun gun that was built combining the Old Power in conjunction with Banner's gamma radiation and that emits pulses that are so strong, the effects are measured on the Richter Scale. At a 1.4 it was able to send Wolverine sailing clear across the street and, according to Banner, at a 6.9 it would be able to kill him.[369]
